Full restatement scan performed: this is a from-scratch build (no prior canonical model existed). Each of the 22 monthly a.xlsx files is the ONLY package covering its own month within 04 Reporting/Period Archive -- no overlapping/consolidated by-month or YTD file exists there. The only other candidate source, 04 Reporting/2026/Q2/June Close/ (qtd-view.xls + monthly-detail.xlsx), was independently re-checked and its June 2026 Revenue/Costs/EBITDA/Debt figures tie EXACTLY to Period Archive/2026/06/a.xlsx -- confirming it is a convenience re-export of the same underlying data, not an independent or restated source; it was excluded (per borrower-config.json's own note) and contributes no restatement. Zero restatements found; restatements.json is an empty array.

Beyond label/structure verification, every one of the following identities was checked and confirmed EXACT (no material variance) across all 22 months, not just June 2026: Revenue-Costs=Gross Profit; Revenue-Costs-OpEx=EBITDA; EBITDA-D&A=Operating Income; Cash Interest+Deferred Financing Fee Amortization=Interest Expense; Operating Income-Interest Expense=Income Before Taxes; Income Before Taxes-Income Tax Expense=Net Income; Net Income+Interest Expense+Income Tax Expense+D&A=EBITDA (the full bridge); Total Assets=sum of asset lines; Gross PP&E+Accumulated Depreciation=Net PP&E; Trade AP+Accrued Expenses+Other Current Liabilities=Accounts Payable and Accruals; Total Liabilities+Equity=Total Assets (balance check=0 every month); Cash Flow ties to both Balance Sheet cash (Ending Cash=BS Cash) and Income Statement EBITDA (CF EBITDA=IS EBITDA) every month; Beginning Debt(t)=Ending Debt(t-1) and Beginning Cash(t)=Ending Cash(t-1) hold continuously across the full 22-month run (i.e. no gap or restatement break at any month boundary); Repayments = 0.60% of that month's own Beginning Debt (the agreement's stated monthly amortization rate) every month. The single exception found: Jan 2025's 'Net Cash from Financing Activities' ($8,607,835.66) does NOT equal -Repayments -- expected, because Jan 2025 is the facility-closing/refinancing month (new $65,360,723.38 term loan proceeds settling the legacy debt payoff), a genuine one-time capital-structure event, not a data error; that row is carried as its own independently-reported figure (not derived by formula) for this reason.

As-reported from the borrower's own 'Cash Flow' tab (not derived) -- the borrower delivers a full Operating/Investing/Financing cash flow every month. 'Net Cash from Operating Activities' is written as a live formula (EBITDA - Working Capital Investment - Cash Taxes - Cash Interest) which ties the reported figure exactly every month; 'Net Cash from Investing Activities' = Capital Expenditures (the only investing line); 'Net Cash from Financing Activities' is carried as its own reported figure (see the Jan 2025 exception above). Memo rows cross-check CF-vs-BS cash and CF-vs-IS EBITDA; both tie to 0 in every month.

No add-back gap; no deemed-EBITDA schedule (a full-text sweep of all 9 executed closing documents found zero 'deemed'/'stipulated'/'agreed EBITDA' hits -- this is a refinancing, not an LBO/acquisition financing with a pre-close target-EBITDA table). This is a NOT PROVISIONAL bridge (a validated covenant-spec.json exists and EBITDA ties exactly).

covenant-spec.json flags that the certified TTM Detail for the 2025-03-31 and 2025-06-30 covenant tests needs monthly Covenant EBITDA back to 2024-04 and 2024-07 respectively, both of which predate this model's earliest month (2024-09) by 5 and 2 months. Those pre-archive months are genuine organic historical actuals the certifier sourced outside 04 Reporting/Period Archive, not a contractual override -- this model was built from 2024-09 forward as instructed; downstream TTM-based reads may show 'insufficient history' for test dates before 2025-09-30, which is expected and not a build defect. 'TTM Covenant EBITDA' on the Debt & Covenant roll-forward below is carried as the borrower's own certified figure for every month (not recomputed as a trailing-12 SUM of this model's own EBITDA row), because a from-model SUM would be wrong (understated) for any month before 2025-09 that lacks a full 12 months of in-model history; for months from 2025-09 onward, the certified figure was independently verified to equal the exact trailing-12-month SUM of this model's own EBITDA row (spot-checked June 2026: sum of Jul 2025-Jun 2026 EBITDA = $24,529,022.34 = the certified TTM figure, exact).

IMPORTANT DEVIATION FROM THE BUILD BRIEF, FOUND ON INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION: the brief's Critical Build Note #3 expected these figures to come from the certified quarterly Covenant Calculation.xlsx (06 Monitoring/Portfolio Management/<YYYY Qn>/), interpolating between quarters. On inspection, that file (both its 'Summary' and 'TTM Detail' tabs, all 6 quarters 2025 Q1-2026 Q2) carries ONLY Funded Debt / TTM Covenant EBITDA / Total Leverage Ratio / Maximum / Status -- it has NO cash-interest or scheduled-principal line at all (this facility has no Fixed-Charges covenant, so the certificate was never built to carry one). The best available certified-equivalent monthly source is instead each month's own a.xlsx 'Debt & Covenant' tab ('Cash Interest' and 'Repayments'), delivered every month (not just quarterly) and verified to reconcile exactly to the 0.60%-of-beginning-debt contractual formula for every month checked -- so it was used directly, with NO interpolation or hold-flat convention needed (a monthly-native source removes the need for one). 'Cash Interest Expense' = that month's Debt & Covenant 'Cash Interest' (a live formula reference for facility months); 'Scheduled Debt Principal Payments' = that month's Debt & Covenant 'Repayments' (a live formula reference for facility months).
